ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The attached figure is a graph of 1/v changing with displacement x; the vertical axis is labeled 1/v/(s·m⁻¹), and the horizontal axis is labeled x/m; the graph line is a straight line rising from O toward the upper right. C and C′ are two position points on the horizontal axis; the vertical dashed line through C intersects the graph line at B, and the vertical dashed line through C′ intersects the graph line at B′. B to B′ is the part of the graph line on this displacement interval, and C to C′ is the bottom side on the horizontal axis. Reasoning: The motion time of the particle from C to C′ satisfies dt=dx/v, so the total time t=∫_C^{C′}(1/v)dx. In the 1/v-x graph, ∫(1/v)dx corresponds to the area below the graph line and above the x-axis between x=C and x=C′. In the figure, this area is enclosed by the left side CB, the upper side BB′, the right side B′C′, and the bottom side C′C, so it is the area of quadrilateral BB′C′C.
